"""通过固定版本的 npm Rust 工具导出配置；不需要 Python 2。"""

import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

from models import Person


PACKAGE_SPEC = "@tsixi/export-config@0.1.2"
REGISTRY = "http://192.168.2.33:4873"


def select_branch(person: Person) -> str:
    branch = person.release_branch if person.build_mode == "release" else person.test_branch
    if person.censor_switch == "true":
        branch = person.censor_branch
    return branch or "master"


def npm_command() -> list[str]:
    # 使用启动打包工具的 Node，避免意外使用 Cocos 或其他软件附带的 Node。
    node = os.environ.get("COCOS_BUILD_LAN_NODE_EXE") or shutil.which("node")
    if not node or not Path(node).is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("未找到 Node.js，请安装含 npm 的 Node.js 并重新启动服务")
    node = Path(node).resolve()
    candidates = [node.parent / "node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js"]
    inherited_npm = os.environ.get("npm_execpath")
    if inherited_npm:
        # npx 启动的服务可能继承 npx-cli.js；它会自动添加 exec，不能当 npm 调用。
        inherited = Path(inherited_npm)
        if inherited.name.lower() in ("npm-cli.js", "npx-cli.js"):
            candidates.append(inherited.with_name("npm-cli.js"))
    npm_wrapper = shutil.which("npm.cmd" if os.name == "nt" else "npm")
    if npm_wrapper:
        wrapper = Path(npm_wrapper)
        candidates.extend([
            wrapper.resolve(),
            wrapper.parent / "node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js",
        ])
    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate.name.lower() == "npm-cli.js" and candidate.is_file():
            return [str(node), str(candidate.resolve())]
    raise RuntimeError("未找到 npm-cli.js，请修复 Node.js/npm 安装后重新启动服务")


def process_person(person: Person):
    # 服务按 UTF-8 解码 stdout/stderr；Windows 默认 stderr 可能仍是 GBK。
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        if hasattr(stream, "reconfigure"):
            stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    try:
        project_root = Path(person.project_path).resolve()
        channel_config = project_root / "python/config/channel.json"
        if not channel_config.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError(f"渠道配置文件不存在：{channel_config}")

        prep_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        config_dir = prep_root / "data" / person.config_name
        runtime_dir = project_root / "tool_data/export_config"
        branch = select_branch(person)
        command = npm_command()
        command.extend([
            "exec", "--yes", "--prefer-offline", f"--registry={REGISTRY}",
            f"--package={PACKAGE_SPEC}", "--", "export-config",
            "-c", person.config_name, "-p", str(config_dir), "-b", branch,
            "--project-root", str(project_root),
            "--channel-config", str(channel_config),
            "--runtime-dir", str(runtime_dir), "--force-export",
        ])
        print(f"配置导出工具：{PACKAGE_SPEC}", flush=True)
        print(f"渠道：{person.config_name}；分支：{branch}", flush=True)
        print(f"目标项目：{project_root}", flush=True)

        env = os.environ.copy()
        # npm 创建的命令入口也应使用同一套 Node。
        env["PATH"] = str(Path(command[0]).parent) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")
        result = subprocess.run(
            command, cwd=project_root, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == "nt" else 0,
            check=False,
        )
    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print(f"配置导出启动失败：{error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1) from error
    if result.returncode:
        print(f"配置导出失败，退出码：{result.returncode}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode if result.returncode > 0 else 1)
    print("配置导出完成", flush=True)

import argparse
import sys
import io
from lib import process_person
from models import Person

if sys.stdout.encoding != 'utf-8':
    sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding='utf-8')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="请输入参数")
    parser.add_argument("--project_path", type=str, required=True, help="请输入project_path")
    parser.add_argument("--config_name", type=str, required=True, help="请输入config_name")
    parser.add_argument("--build_mode", type=str, required=True, help="请输入build_mode")
    parser.add_argument("--censor_switch", type=str, required=True, help="请输入censor_switch")
    parser.add_argument("--test_branch", type=str, required=False, help="请输入test_branch")
    parser.add_argument("--censor_branch", type=str, required=False, help="请输入censor_branch")
    parser.add_argument("--release_branch", type=str, required=False, help="请输入release_branch")

    args = parser.parse_args()
    person = Person(project_path=args.project_path, config_name=args.config_name, build_mode=args.build_mode, censor_switch=args.censor_switch, test_branch=args.test_branch, censor_branch=args.censor_branch, release_branch=args.release_branch)
    process_person(person)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Person:
    project_path: str
    config_name: str
    build_mode: str
    censor_switch: str
    test_branch: str = None
    censor_branch: str = None
    release_branch: str = None
